summary: Created three API routes: /api/visuals/attrition-by-income, /api/visuals/attrition-by-card-category, and /api/visuals/attrition-by-spend-quintile. Each route loads cleaned data, applies optional filters, computes grouped attrition metrics, and returns the data in the expected array format.
action_summary: Created three new API routes for bar chart visuals showing attrition rates by different customer segments.
implementation_notes: Reused existing helpers for data loading, filtering, and aggregation. Each route follows the standard pattern: load data, parse and apply filters, group by segment field, compute metrics, and return as array.
